Every Tuesday, April 14-June 2
Leaving North Bellevue Community Center at 10 a.m., returning by 2 p.m.
◼ This easy hiking series is designed for active older adults looking to explore the beautiful
trails around Bellevue. Locations subject to change based on conditions and weather.
◼ We will meet at the North Bellevue Community Center and ride to a trailhead in the Issaquah
Alps, Cascades, or other scenic areas nearby.
◼ Hikes will be about 2 miles and specifically chosen for the over 50 crowd.
◼ Dress for the weather and bring a lunch and water.
◼ Transportation provided.
◼ Fee per hike - $8 Resident, $10 Non-Resident.
◼ Pre-registration is required call 425-452-6885, or online at Register.BellevueWA.gov
April 14 Sky Country Trailhead 3 star rating system
April 21 Evans Creek Preserve = easy
April 28 Tradition Lake = mild
May 5 Oxbow Lake Loop = moderate
May 12 Franklin Falls
May 19 Osprey Park
May 26 Redmond Watershed
June 2 Twin Falls

For alternate formats, interpreters, or reasonable modification requests please phone at least 48 hours in 02886-62-SCP
advance 425-324-0778 (voice) or email tracks@bellevuewa.gov. For complaints regarding modifications,
contact the City of Bellevue ADA, Title VI, and Equal Opportunity Officer at ADATitleVI@bellevuewa.gov.
